items.text: Moral rules are created by societies to help people live together.
Moral rules ultimately come from a source beyond human society.
What is moral is decided by human agreements and institutions.
Moral authority is grounded in a divine or transcendent reality.
Morality is a human invention that can evolve over time.
There is a higher moral order independent of human opinions.
Moral standards are established by people rather than by any higher power.
Moral truth is anchored in something beyond human culture.
